capabilities: insert icons into notes via an icon picker
toggle supported icon sets in settings
customize icon color and size with CSS snippets
extras: The author labels the plugin experimental and asks that bugs be reported as GitHub issues. The README lists licenses for the bundled icon sets, and the API documentation link is truncated in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert icon glyphs into notes.

relations.evidence: Inspired by obsidian-citation-plugin and based on obsidian-sample-plugin.
Inspired by obsidian-citation-plugin and based on obsidian-sample-plugin.
This plugin uses react-icons to render icons via a Markdown postprocessor.

summary: Icon picker that inserts Remix Icon and FontAwesome glyphs into notes, rendered through a Markdown postprocessor.
